title: Compliance Analyst
why_fit: Supports the broker-dealer compliance program; 2-4 years of broker-dealer compliance asked, which is the gap, but his Northrop model audits and controls work map to compliance testing.
why_us: The Compliance Analyst role at Wellington supports the firm's limited-purpose broker-dealer, Wellington Funds Distributors, and that means maintaining policies, running compliance testing and following regulatory changes. I like that the work is about controls and evidence rather than sales. At Northrop Grumman I audited 100+ financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and at AMG Family Dental I built reconciliation checks that flag underpaid claims. I have not worked in a broker-dealer, but I am used to testing a process, documenting what I find and following up until it is fixed.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Compliance Analyst position on Wellington Management's Legal & Compliance team. I will be direct about the gap: the posting asks for 2-4 years of broker-dealer compliance experience, and I have not worked inside a broker-dealer. What I bring is hands-on experience testing financial work against controls.

As a Financial Analyst Intern at Northrop Grumman, I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls. That meant checking inputs and logic, documenting what did not hold up, and explaining the issue to the people who owned the model. I also presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership, so I am comfortable raising a finding with people who did not want to hear it.

Since August 2023 I have been Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, where I direct billing, collections and revenue tracking. I automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation in Python, cutting processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up. Better reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix also helped me recover more than $500K in annual revenue. Your posting asks for data analysis skills and attention to detail, and that is the work I do every week.

I hold a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk University and an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis. I have not taken the SIE or Series exams, but I would be willing to study for them. I am a US citizen, available immediately, and can work from your Boston office.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian

title: Inside Sales Representative (Hybrid - Waltham, MA / Boston, MA)
location: Waltham or Boston, MA (hybrid, 3 days in office)
why_fit: Posting accepts a bachelor's degree or one year of sales experience; he has no sales experience but a strong follow-up and numbers record.
why_us: This role is a one-call-close job selling Constant Contact's marketing tools to small business owners, and I like that you coach on objections and track results every day. I am moving into sales from finance, and I think that helps: small business owners care about cost, return and cash flow, and I run those numbers for a practice every day at AMG Family Dental. I also learned that persistent follow-up pays. Chasing underpaid claims recovered more than $500K a year. I want a job where effort shows up in the results.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Inside Sales Representative position in Waltham or Boston. I am making a deliberate move from finance into sales, and I want to be upfront that I have no formal sales experience. The posting asks for a bachelor's degree or a year of sales experience, and I meet it through my degrees: a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk University and an M.A. in International Economics and Finance from Brandeis.

What I can offer is a close understanding of how small business owners think about money. At AMG Family Dental in Belmont I am the Financial Manager, so I build the annual budget and explain budget-versus-actual results to the owners. When someone asks what a tool costs and what it returns, I know how they will judge the answer.

Your posting describes a fast, one-call-close environment with objections to work through. The closest thing in my background is insurance claim follow-up. I contacted payers repeatedly about underpaid claims, stayed organized across a long list of open items, and kept going when the answer was no. That follow-up helped me recover more than $500K in annual revenue and reduce A/R aging by 10%.

I communicate well. At Northrop Grumman I presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership, and at FYND in Tokyo I presented AI recommendations to the co-founders. I am also a competitive team player: a 2023 Brandeis intramural basketball champion, and an executive board member of the Armenian Church Youth Organization of America.

I am a US citizen, available immediately, and happy to be in the office three days a week. I am ready to be coached.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
